messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: continuous-optimization basin-hopping over the 26-dim configuration space

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Continuous-optimization basin-hopping over the 26-dimensional configuration space converges to a configuration of 13 points in the unit square whose minimum triangle area among all 286 triangles equals exactly 1/120, and this optimum is achieved by placing one point at the center of the square and the remaining 12 points on two concentric hexagonal rings at radii r1 and r2 with alternating angular offsets, where the optimal radii are algebraic numbers solving the system that equalizes the areas of the four smallest triangle types (center-adjacent-inner, center-inner-outer, inner-inner-inner, and inner-outer-outer)."}
